This Halloween, night falls and a mysterious party
quietly begins! Ghosts and monsters are roaming,
surprises are waiting, and brave adventurers are
invited to join the event to unlock limited-time festival
skins and unique decorations! Mystery grand prizes
are also waiting to be revealed!
Get ready for a Halloween carnival filled with thrills
and fun!
